answer_1.quote: We follow the standard methodology for quantitatively investigating memorization in LLMs, as illustrated in Figure. In this methodology, an LLM is given a prompt and generates the continuation.

answer_2.quote: Verbatim memorization refers to the exact reproduction of text from the training corpus, while approximate memorization allows for slight variations. ... Approximate memorization: The suffix s is recognized as approximately memorized if the BLEU score between s and f(p) exceeds a certain threshold.

answer_4.quote: One of the authors manually examined 20 memorized examples for each of the Pythia 12B and LLM-jp 13B models.
answer_4.guideline: to explore the characteristics of the memorized texts and their plausible reasons for being flagged as approximately memorized
